lines.gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਦੇਖਿਓ ਬੇੜਾ ਜਰਜਰਾ ਤਬ ਉਤਰਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਹਉ ਫਰਕਿ ॥੬੭॥
lines.transliteration: jab dekhio beRaa jarajaraa tab utar pario hau pharak ||67||
lines.translation: When I saw that my boat was rotten, then I immediately got out. ||67||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਪਾਪੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਭਾਵਈ ਹਰਿ ਪੂਜਾ ਨ ਸੁਹਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer paapee bhagat na bhaavaee har poojaa na suhaai ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, the sinner does not like devotion to the Lord; he does not appreciate worship.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਖੀ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਪਰਹਰੈ ਜਹ ਬਿਗੰਧ ਤਹ ਜਾਇ ॥੬੮॥
lines.transliteration: maakhee cha(n)dan paraharai jah biga(n)dh tah jaai ||68||
lines.translation: The fly abandons the sandalwood tree, and goes after the rotten smell. ||68||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਬੈਦੁ ਮੂਆ ਰੋਗੀ ਮੂਆ ਮੂਆ ਸਭੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer baid mooaa rogee mooaa mooaa sabh sa(n)saar ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, the physician is dead, and the patient is dead; the whole world is dead.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਕਬੀਰਾ ਨਾ ਮੂਆ ਜਿਹ ਨਾਹੀ ਰੋਵਨਹਾਰੁ ॥੬੯॥
lines.transliteration: ek kabeeraa naa mooaa jih naahee rovanahaar ||69||
lines.translation: Only Kabeer is not dead; there is no one to mourn for him. ||69||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਧਿਆਇਓ ਮੋਟੀ ਲਾਗੀ ਖੋਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer raam na dhiaaio motee laagee khor ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, I have not meditated on the Lord; such is the bad habit I have developed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਹਾਂਡੀ ਕਾਠ ਕੀ ਨਾ ਓਹ ਚਰ੍ਹੈ ਬਹੋਰਿ ॥੭੦॥
lines.transliteration: kaaiaa haa(n)dee kaath kee naa oh charhai bahor ||70||
lines.translation: The body is a wooden pot; it cannot be put back on the fire. ||70||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਐਸੀ ਹੋਇ ਪਰੀ ਮਨ ਕੋ ਭਾਵਤੁ ਕੀਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer aisee hoi paree man ko bhaavat keen ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, it came to pass, that I did whatever I pleased.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਰਨੇ ਤੇ ਕਿਆ ਡਰਪਨਾ ਜਬ ਹਾਥਿ ਸਿਧਉਰਾ ਲੀਨ ॥੭੧॥
lines.transliteration: marane te kiaa darapanaa jab haath sidhauraa leen ||71||
lines.translation: Why should I be afraid of death? I have invited death for myself. ||71||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਰਸ ਕੋ ਗਾਂਡੋ ਚੂਸੀਐ ਗੁਨ ਕਉ ਮਰੀਐ ਰੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer ras ko gaa(n)do chooseeai gun kau mareeai roi ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, the mortals suck at the sugar cane, for the sake of the sweet juice. They should work just as hard for virtue.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਵਗੁਨੀਆਰੇ ਮਾਨਸੈ ਭਲੋ ਨ ਕਹਿਹੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੭੨॥
lines.transliteration: avaguneeaare maanasai bhalo na kahihai koi ||72||
lines.translation: The person who lacks virtue - no one calls him good. ||72||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਗਾਗਰਿ ਜਲ ਭਰੀ ਆਜੁ ਕਾਲੑਿ ਜੈਹੈ ਫੂਟਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer gaagar jal bharee aaj kaalhi jaihai phoot ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, the pitcher is full of water; it will break, today or tomorrow.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਜੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਹਿ ਆਪਨੋ ਅਧ ਮਾਝਿ ਲੀਜਹਿਗੇ ਲੂਟਿ ॥੭੩॥
lines.transliteration: gur j na chetahi aapano adh maajh leejahige loot ||73||
lines.translation: Those who do not remember their Guru, shall be plundered on the way. ||73||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਕੂਕਰੁ ਰਾਮ ਕੋ ਮੁਤੀਆ ਮੇਰੋ ਨਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer kookar raam ko muteeaa mero naau ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, I am the Lord's dog; Moti is my name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਲੇ ਹਮਾਰੇ ਜੇਵਰੀ ਜਹ ਖਿੰਚੈ ਤਹ ਜਾਉ ॥੭੪॥
lines.transliteration: gale hamaare jevaree jah khi(n)chai tah jaau ||74||
lines.translation: There is a chain around my neck; wherever I am pulled, I go. ||74||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਜਪਨੀ ਕਾਠ ਕੀ ਕਿਆ ਦਿਖਲਾਵਹਿ ਲੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer japanee kaath kee kiaa dikhalaavahi loi ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, why do you show other people your rosary beads?

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਹੀ ਇਹ ਜਪਨੀ ਕਿਆ ਹੋਇ ॥੭੫॥
lines.transliteration: hiradai raam na chetahee ih japanee kiaa hoi ||75||
lines.translation: You do not remember the Lord in your heart, so what use is this rosary to you? ||75||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਬਿਰਹੁ ਭੁਯੰਗਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਬਸੈ ਮੰਤੁ ਨ ਮਾਨੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer birahu bhuya(n)gam man basai ma(n)t na maanai koi ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, the snake of separation from the Lord abides within my mind; it does not respond to any mantra.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਬਿਓਗੀ ਨਾ ਜੀਐ ਜੀਐ ਤ ਬਉਰਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੭੬॥
lines.transliteration: raam biogee naa jeeai jeeai ta bauraa hoi ||76||
lines.translation: One who is separated from the Lord does not live; if he does live, he goes insane. ||76||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਪਾਰਸ ਚੰਦਨੈ ਤਿਨੑ ਹੈ ਏਕ ਸੁਗੰਧ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer paaras cha(n)danai tinh hai ek suga(n)dh ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, the philosopher's stone and sandalwood oil have the same good quality.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਹ ਮਿਲਿ ਤੇਊ ਊਤਮ ਭਏ ਲੋਹ ਕਾਠ ਨਿਰਗੰਧ ॥੭੭॥
lines.transliteration: tih mil teoo ootam bhae loh kaath niraga(n)dh ||77||
lines.translation: Whatever comes into contact with them is uplifted. Iron is transformed into gold, and ordinary wood becomes fragrant. ||77||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਠੇਂਗਾ ਬੁਰਾ ਹੈ ਓਹੁ ਨਹੀ ਸਹਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer jam kaa the(n)gaa buraa hai ohu nahee sahiaa jaai ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, Death's club is terrible; it cannot be endured.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਜੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਮੋੁਹਿ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਤਿਨੑਿ ਲੀਆ ਅੰਚਲਿ ਲਾਇ ॥੭੮॥
lines.transliteration: ek j saadhoo mouhi milio tinhi leeaa a(n)chal laai ||78||
lines.translation: I have met with the holy man; he has attached me to the hem of his robe. ||78||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਬੈਦੁ ਕਹੈ ਹਉ ਹੀ ਭਲਾ ਦਾਰੂ ਮੇਰੈ ਵਸਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer baid kahai hau hee bhalaa daaroo merai vas ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, the physician says that he alone is good, and all the medicine is under his control.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹ ਤਉ ਬਸਤੁ ਗੁਪਾਲ ਕੀ ਜਬ ਭਾਵੈ ਲੇਇ ਖਸਿ ॥੭੯॥
lines.transliteration: ih tau basat gupaal kee jab bhaavai lei khas ||79||
lines.translation: But these things belong to the Lord; He takes them away whenever He wishes. ||79||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਨਉਬਤਿ ਆਪਨੀ ਦਿਨ ਦਸ ਲੇਹੁ ਬਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer naubat aapanee din das lehu bajaai ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, take your drum and beat it for ten days.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਦੀ ਨਾਵ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਜਿਉ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਮਿਲਹੈ ਆਇ ॥੮੦॥
lines.transliteration: nadee naav sa(n)jog jiu bahur na milahai aai ||80||
lines.translation: Life is like people meeting on a boat on a river; they shall not meet again. ||80||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਸਾਤ ਸਮੁੰਦਹਿ ਮਸੁ ਕਰਉ ਕਲਮ ਕਰਉ ਬਨਰਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer saat samu(n)dahi mas karau kalam karau banaraai ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, if I could change the seven seas into ink and make all the vegetation my pen,

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਸੁਧਾ ਕਾਗਦੁ ਜਉ ਕਰਉ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਲਿਖਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੮੧॥
lines.transliteration: basudhaa kaagad jau karau har jas likhan na jaai ||81||
lines.translation: and the earth my paper, even then, I could not write the Praises of the Lord. ||81||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਜਾਤਿ ਜੁਲਾਹਾ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਬਸੇ ਗੁਪਾਲ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer jaat julaahaa kiaa karai hiradai base gupaal ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, what can my lowly status as a weaver do to me? The Lord dwells in my heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਰਮਈਆ ਕੰਠਿ ਮਿਲੁ ਚੂਕਹਿ ਸਰਬ ਜੰਜਾਲ ॥੮੨॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer ramaeeaa ka(n)th mil chookahi sarab ja(n)jaal ||82||
lines.translation: Kabeer, the Lord hugs me close in His Embrace; I have forsaken all my entanglements. ||82||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਐਸਾ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਦੇਇ ਜਰਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer aisaa ko nahee ma(n)dar dei jaraai ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, will anyone set fire to his home

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਂਚਉ ਲਰਿਕੇ ਮਾਰਿ ਕੈ ਰਹੈ ਰਾਮ ਲਿਉ ਲਾਇ ॥੮੩॥
lines.transliteration: paa(n)chau larike maar kai rahai raam liu laai ||83||
lines.translation: and kill his five sons (the five thieves) to remain lovingly attached to the Lord? ||83||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਐਸਾ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਫੂਕਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer aisaa ko nahee ihu tan devai phook ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, will anyone burn his own body?

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਧਾ ਲੋਗੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਈ ਰਹਿਓ ਕਬੀਰਾ ਕੂਕਿ ॥੮੪॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)dhaa log na jaanaee rahio kabeeraa kook ||84||
lines.translation: The people are blind - they do not know, although Kabeer continues to shout at them. ||84||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਸਤੀ ਪੁਕਾਰੈ ਚਿਹ ਚੜੀ ਸੁਨੁ ਹੋ ਬੀਰ ਮਸਾਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer satee pukaarai chih chaRee sun ho beer masaan ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, the widow mounts the funeral pyre and cries out, "Listen, O brother funeral pyre.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲੋਗੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ਚਲਿ ਗਇਓ ਹਮ ਤੁਮ ਕਾਮੁ ਨਿਦਾਨ ॥੮੫॥
lines.transliteration: log sabaaiaa chal gaio ham tum kaam nidaan ||85||
lines.translation: All people must depart in the end; it is only you and I." ||85||
